test_cases.title: Verify user can log in with valid credentials
test_cases.description: Confirm the login flow accepts a registered user and navigates to the home screen.
test_cases.preconditions: User account exists. App is installed and network is reachable.
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and lands on the Dashboard screen without errors.

steps.action: Open the application on the device.
steps.expected: Splash screen appears and the Login screen loads within 3 seconds.

steps.action: Enter a registered username and correct password in the respective fields.
steps.expected: Input fields accept the text. No validation errors are shown.
steps.notes: Use the test account credentials documented in the test data sheet.

steps.expected: Authentication succeeds. App navigates to the Dashboard screen. User's name or avatar is visible in the header.
